csv_project_name: AE for Old River Road Widening Ph 1
csv_scope_of_work: Chatham County in coordination with Effingham County, is soliciting Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) from qualified consulting firms to provide engineering design services for the Old River Road Widening Project. The project consists of widening approximately three (3) miles of Old River Road from a two-lane rural roadway to a four-lane divided facility extending from State Route 204 in Chatham County to Interstate 16 in Effingham County. The project will include roadway reconstruction, additional pavement structure, drainage improvements, safety and operational enhancements, access management, intersection improvements, traffic control features, utility coordination, bike shoulders and associated multimodal accommodations.
